retrieval.metric_definition: Recall@K is query hit-rate: at least one expected source appears in top K. Precision@K is relevant retrieved sources divided by K, averaged over answerable questions. MRR uses the first expected source rank.

external_validation.evidence_source: user-provided terminal output from the uploaded project working copy

pytest.warning: StarletteDeprecationWarning: Using httpx with starlette.testclient is deprecated; install httpx2 instead.

report_generation.interpretation: Reconciles saved retrieval, generation, and performance artifacts; it does not run a fresh end-to-end RAG benchmark.

external_validation.verification_note: These terminal results were supplied by the project operator and were not independently rerun in the report-generation environment.

performance.warning: Performance is a separate historical run; do not combine its status counts with the generation run.

limitations: No fresh end-to-end execution was possible in this environment: faiss and sentence-transformers are unavailable and package installation is blocked by network/DNS.
Semantic generation metrics remain not_measured; lexical citation overlap is not semantic entailment.
The archived retrieval, generation, and performance results come from different runs and are reported separately.
Provider live-failure and concurrency tests require the configured local LLM/embedding services and a fully provisioned environment.
